Cherry Hills Village, Colorado — A NoCo Realtor's Notes On A Denver-Metro Enclave

Cherry Hills Village sits about 30 minutes south of downtown Denver in Arapahoe County — the kind of established residential enclave that shows up in national rankings of the wealthiest zip codes in the country. If you found this page, you are likely either researching a move to Cherry Hills from out of state, or you are a Northern Colorado client of mine weighing a metro-Denver purchase after a job change or a downsizing decision. Both are conversations I have regularly.

The honest disclosure first: my day-in, day-out business is Northern Colorado — Loveland, Fort Collins, Windsor, Berthoud, and the surrounding towns. Cherry Hills is a metro-Denver market, and any buyer or seller working there deserves an agent who lives and closes in that market weekly. What I do for NoCo clients relocating to Cherry Hills — or considering it as one of several options — is help you decide whether it is even the right fit before you spend the airfare on tours, and connect you with a vetted metro-Denver agent for the transaction itself when it is. That referral is a real service, not a handoff to whoever answers the phone.

What Cherry Hills Village Actually Is

Population under 7,000. Median home price at the time of writing is above $2.5 million, with a meaningful share of transactions closing between $3M and $10M. Lot sizes are generous — the village's zoning code has kept large-lot residential intact through fifty years of Denver-metro sprawl — and equestrian easements run through much of the community. The public schools are in the Cherry Creek School District, which regularly ranks among the state's strongest. The village has its own police and public works, no commercial zoning, and a working land-use process that keeps redevelopment slow.

Who Cherry Hills Fits

  • Buyers with a genuine $3M+ budget who want quiet, established, and low-density inside the Denver-metro perimeter.
  • Families prioritizing Cherry Creek School District access.
  • Owners of horses or working equestrian setups — the village is one of the few metro-adjacent communities where that lifestyle still functions.
  • Buyers who want to be close to Denver Tech Center, DIA, and downtown Denver on the same drive.

Who Cherry Hills Doesn't Fit

  • Buyers looking for walkable downtown or restaurant density — the village is purely residential, so evenings out mean a drive.
  • Buyers who want the mountains as a daily feature — Cherry Hills is 30 minutes from foothills access, 90+ minutes from the first ski areas.
  • Buyers who value a smaller-town or working-community feel — this is a residential enclave, and the culture reflects that.

The NoCo Alternative Worth Considering

If what draws you to Cherry Hills is large lots, strong schools, and the option of equestrian use inside a well-established community, Northern Colorado has that same combination at a meaningfully lower price point — Boyd Lake in Loveland, the foothills west of Fort Collins, the Timnath and Windsor luxury pockets, and the working farm-and-ranch belt north of Wellington. For homes in the estate and luxury tier, my dedicated luxury brand — [Signature Property Collection](https://signaturepropertycollection.com) — is built for exactly that market.

Worth a real conversation before you commit to a Cherry Hills search. Some clients look at NoCo, see the price difference, and stay. Some look and confirm that Cherry Hills is where they want to be. Both are legitimate answers.

How Christine Helps NoCo Clients Considering Cherry Hills

  1. An honest first conversation about what you're actually optimizing for — schools, commute, lot size, budget, or lifestyle — and whether Cherry Hills, another Denver-metro enclave, or a NoCo alternative is the better fit.
  2. If Cherry Hills is the answer, a vetted introduction to an agent who works that market weekly, with the credentials and track record to justify the price point.
  3. If your Cherry Hills purchase is contingent on the sale of a NoCo home, I handle the NoCo side — bold marketing, strategic pricing, and fierce negotiation — while your Cherry Hills agent handles theirs.
